title: Fresh scenario clones reuse the seed's pack index
goal: A git scenario's clone or worktree of the kb seed starts with the pack index the session built once for the seed commit, so no tool run in it rebuilds the index for unchanged content; tests that test index building keep their own index directory.
links: kb/public/python/pytest-xdist.md (session fixture once per worker, FileLock pattern)
notes: Deferred, outside any sprint: kbfacts.fingerprint hashes each file's mtime_ns and the absolute root paths, so a clone at another path never matches the seed's index file and a copied index is never read. It needs a fingerprint independent of the clone's path and mtimes (_tools/kbfacts.py, outside these touches) and a Windows measurement first: on the Mac a fresh clone's first rag.py pack costs about 3 s cold against 0.05 s warm, about 10% of the scenario files' time; the Windows premise (check.py 14.5 s cold, 25-35% of worker time) is file-cache and Defender cost. kbfacts.store() prunes other indexes of its root in the same directory, so a shared KB_INDEX directory across scenarios could delete a file another test holds open on Windows; a per-clone copy avoids that. Its checks name perfcheck.py (ST-c35i7vjx). Its full tests.py and perfcheck ids checks pass before the work by design: they guard that the speed-up loses no test; -k seed_index and the time bound are what the work must make pass.
